title: I Filmed My Sister Sleepwalking. She Wasn't Walking Alone #shorts #scarystories
description:
Every night at 3:40 my sister got up and walked to the attic. The hallway camera showed who was leading her.

Follow for new scary stories every day.

#scarystory #foundfootage #creepy #shorts

beats.text: This is my sister June, at 3:40 in the morning. She's asleep.
Last winter, she started sleepwalking. Every single night.
Mom and Dad told me to film her, so the doctor could see it.
So I set up a camera in the hallway and waited up with my camcorder.
Night one, June walked to the attic door and stood there for an hour.
Night two, she opened it and whispered, okay, I'm coming.
At breakfast, she didn't remember any of it.
Then I watched the hallway camera from night three.
June wasn't walking by herself.
A thin man was walking in front of her. Holding her hand.
Dad checked the whole house. Every lock was closed.
So the next night, I followed them up the attic stairs.
June walked straight to the back wall and knocked twice.
Something on the other side knocked back.
A board slid open. A face looked out at my camera.
I screamed. June woke up. The board slammed shut.
The police tore that wall open before sunrise.
Behind it was a tiny room. A mattress. Empty food cans.
And a hole in the floor, looking down into June's bedroom.
He had been living above us for over a year.
beats.card: POLICE REPORT: HIDDEN ROOM IN ATTIC. OCCUPIED APPROX. 14 MONTHS. SUSPECT NOT FOUND.

beats.text: He used to whisper to her through the hole, every night, until she came to him.
They never found him. We moved out that same week.
June doesn't sleepwalk anymore.
But last night, I checked the camera in our new hallway.
At 3:40, someone knocked twice on our attic door.
And from her bed, still asleep, June whispered, okay. I'm coming.
